verdict.rationale: Fly.io's Sprite disks grow as data is written, up to 100 GB per Sprite, and are billed only for the bytes actually stored, which matches both parts of the story. The only evidence is a single marketing-page claim, and it is limited to Sprites (not shown for Fly Volumes on Machines). Missing for 10: in-depth pricing/storage docs (per-GB rate, how shrinking or deletes are billed), confirmation that this applies beyond Sprites to Machines/Volumes, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a devops-lead, I know attached disk/storage auto-grows with usage and I'm billed only for bytes actually written rather than pre-provisioned capacity

citations.quote: Your disk grows as you write it, up to 100 GB per Sprite, and you're only billed for the bytes you actually put there.
